en.title: Minimum Contiguous Segments Without Repeated Characters
en.description:
Split the string into non-empty, disjoint contiguous segments so that each character belongs to exactly one segment and no character repeats within a segment. Find the minimum number of segments.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string of length 1..200000.
hints: Maintain the set of characters in the current segment; when a repeated character appears, cut right before it and start a new segment.
